//EXPERIMENT_SS: 2026-10-15 (owner: the rsztf sign-off is not accepted, ss far worse than R14). Measured on the signed 6c4ccffd layouts (results/ss_study_20261015): the ss loss sits in paths that are critical only at ss (DM: load data in W -> forwarding -> trap / stall cone into every pipeline register, max_ss -16.8 vs -7.1 on R14; SA2: if_req_addr -> I$ hit -> next-PC cone, -10.3 vs -7.0). With RSZ_CORNERS tt / ff no resizer step sees them. Change: PL_RESIZER_CORNERS = tt / ss / ff (local variable: the post-CTS timing repair alone also works on ss); every other resizer step stays on tt / ff, so the post-GRT repair still closes the tt paths (DM half-cycle RAM -> D$ refill).
//EXPERIMENT_SS_CELLS: 2026-10-15 third ss step. rszctsall_r1 (ss proxy nom_ss -8.96) still trails R14 (-7.04 on the same proxy) by ~3 ns in the trap / stall cone; the gap is logic, not wire (calibrated RC moves the proxy by 0.03 ns). On its 50 worst ss paths or4b / or3b carry 16 % of the delay at 1.0-1.1 ns per cell: the or3 / or4 families (NOR + inverter, 3-4 stacked PMOS) have the highest ss / tt ratio of the library (2.15-2.27, median 1.68; results/ss_study_20261015/lib_ss_tt_ratio_s0.2_l0.005.txt). The PDK already keeps their _1 sizes out of synthesis, but ABC maps the _2 / _4 sizes and the resizer may size them down. Change: EXTRA_EXCLUDED_CELLS or4* / or3* (synthesis and PnR), so ABC builds those ORs from NAND / NOR 2-3 trees.
